slots.hypothesis: The core is the volume-timing centroid behind head +1.39, with trading pushed toward the open as the good side. The same idea, measured independently as the last-30-minute amount share, gave head +1.30. Its valid/train ratio of 1.14 is the lowest in the library, and all of the alpha sits in the 10-40 day persistent component. The only periphery seen so far is smoothing plus neg. This slot adds four new kinds of periphery, each a test that can fail: (a) screens that push names with limit-lock or frozen days (ts_max of day_flat_run_max / day_at_max_ratio / day_at_min_ratio over 20 days) to the bottom, plus a pool version; (b) the cross-day ts_corr of the centroid with the open-to-close return, testing the late-day price-pushing mechanism (Hillion-Suominen, Comerton-Forde-Putnins), used alone, as a screen and as a pool; (c) the centroid against its own 120/240-day baseline, separating the persistent trait from transitory shifts (Cremers-Mei); (d) a pool of names with a low closing-auction share, the passive-fund footprint (Shen-Shi). 13 seeds. Control-bucket ranking was left out on purpose: it would be ~0.85 with the head, and both the table and the library ban would remove it.

Where volume trades on the intraday price path. The idea: buying volume at local intraday highs is attention-driven retail chasing (Barber-Odean 2008). T+1 and short-sale limits keep it from being arbitraged the same day, so it reverses over the following weeks (Campbell-Grossman-Wang 1993; Llorente et al. 2002; the negative price-volume correlation alphas in Kakushadze 2016). The main measure is day_corr of the minute price against its 30/60-minute rolling mean with sqrt(Volume), negated and smoothed over 20-60 days. A div(M,M) NaN mask removes the opening and closing auctions (minutes 1-237 kept, checked on the operator). Together these strip out the open-to-close direction x volume-timing confound, which belongs to the centroid family. Further variants: VWAP minus TWAP over minute volatility, and the Kyle-impact top-10% minutes' VWAP against the continuous-session VWAP over minute volatility. Two raw day_corr(Close, Volume) seeds are kept as controls. 13 seeds. All are scale-free, use no convex transforms, no constants and no control functions.
